info.name: Get all alerts of the current user's feed (V2)

params.name: collectionIds
params.description: Collection IDs to filter the feed by. Only alerts for targets in these collections will be returned. In V1 this was collectionId (singular); same comma-separated IDs.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the date range (inclusive). Use UTC ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`). If omitted, V2 returns alerts from the last 90 days filtered by `createdAt`. In V1 you could use `newerThan` (milliseconds) or `from`; V2 uses `from` only.

params.name: perspectiveId
params.description: Perspective ID to filter the feed by. Defaults to the user's default perspective.

params.name: priorities
params.description: List of priorities to filter the feed by Allowed values: Low, Mid, High, Critical (comma-separated).

params.name: includeGeo
params.description: If set to true, the response will include the geo information. Set to true when you need coordinates or shapes for mapping.

params.name: impactLevelIds
params.description: Impact level IDs to filter the feed by. Valid IDs depend on your tenant configuration.

params.name: minTier
params.description: Minimum supply chain tier depth to include (V2 only). Tier 1 = direct suppliers, Tier 2 = their suppliers, etc. Default 1. Must be ≤ maxTier; max value 5.

params.name: maxTier
params.description: Maximum supply chain tier depth to include (V2 only). Tier 1 = direct suppliers, Tier 2 = their suppliers, etc. Default 1. Must be ≥ minTier; max value 5.

params.name: newerThan
params.description: ⚠️ **DEPRECATED** - Use `from` parameter instead. Only return alerts that are newer than the given timestamp (Timestamp in milliseconds). This parameter is deprecated in favor of ISO 8601 date format.

params.name: from
params.description: Only return alerts that are newer than the given date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2020-12-31T23:59). This parameter replaces the deprecated `newerThan` parameter.

params.name: perspectiveId
params.description: Perspective ID to filter the feed by. Defaults to the user's default perspective. The perspective determines which risk factors and scoring weights are applied to alerts.

params.description: List of priorities to filter the feed by

params.name: includeGeo
params.description: If set to true, the response will include the geo information.

params.name: impactLevelIds
params.description: Impact level IDs to filter the feed by. Only alerts with these impact levels will be returned.
